title: Settings
overview: This guide covers settings workflows for Practice Admin.

subtasks.title: Account Setting
subtasks.purpose: View the Practice Admin’s own profile, adjust session timeout, toggle Two Way Authentication and clear cached data.

steps.title: Open Account Setting
steps.description: Click Settings in the sidebar. The Account Setting tab is selected by default.

steps.title: Review Account Fields
steps.description: Review Full Name, Username, Email, Phone and Fax in the read-only Account Settings panel (edit these from the master user record under the practice profile).

steps.title: View Session Time
steps.description: View the Current Session Time (e.g., 30 minutes).

steps.title: Update Session Timeout
steps.description: Enter a new value in Session Time (minutes) and click Update to change the timeout.

steps.title: Toggle Two-Factor Auth
steps.description: Click the Two Way Authentication chip (Enabled / Disabled) to toggle 2FA for this account.

steps.title: Refresh Cached Data
steps.description: Click Refresh under Clear Cache to purge cached data for this user session. Notes Session Time controls how long the app can be idle before the user is signed out. Toggling 2FA to Enabled will require a one-time code on the next login; Disabled reverts to password-only. Clear Cache does not sign the user out — it only forces a fresh fetch of lookup lists and static configuration.

subtasks.title: Follow Up Setting
subtasks.purpose: Configure the thresholds that drive the Care Mgmt → Follow Up Query — when a patient becomes eligible for outreach based on missed uploads or abnormal readings.

steps.title: Set Upload Threshold
steps.description: Set the minimum days since last upload before a patient is flagged.

steps.title: Set Reading Threshold
steps.description: Set the minimum readings expected per billing window.

steps.title: Set Escalation Window
steps.description: Set the escalation window (days after which a missed follow-up is escalated to the provider).

steps.title: Save Follow-Up Setting
steps.description: Click Save to apply. Notes These thresholds are the input filter for Care Mgmt → Follow Up (see 7.12.1). Loosening them reduces the flagged list; tightening them increases outreach volume. Changes apply on the next Query run — existing dismissed rows are not re-flagged retroactively.

subtasks.title: Calendar Permission Settings
subtasks.purpose: Control which roles inside the practice can access the Calendar module (view, book, edit, cancel) and manage the Calendar Setting sub-pages.

steps.title: Toggle Role Calendar Access
steps.description: For each role row (Provider, Practice Caregiver, System Caregiver, …), toggle the Calendar access switch on or off.

steps.title: Expand Granular Permissions
steps.description: Where applicable, expand the row to grant granular permissions (Visit Type, Working Hours, Book, Reschedule, Cancel).

steps.title: Save Calendar Permissions
steps.description: Click Save to apply. Notes Permission changes take effect on the affected user’s next page load — no re-login required. Disabling Calendar for a role also hides the Visit Type and Working Hours sub-pages for that role. 8. Provider Task 8.1 — Dashboard
